messages:
mira: Quick note — brought up v3.1-int4 on staging for a short smoke. Goal: validate A/B gating rules and dynamic shadowing before prod canary.
devon: What are the gating signals this time? last time we missed a long-doc drift.
mira: Plan: staged steps 4% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%. Signals: slice MRR delta, hallucation delta, structured exact-match. Soft-hold if halluc delta > 0.003 for 20m. Auto-fallback after 25m sustained.
sam: Add routing override: any session with > 6k tokens goes to v3.0-nf4. Also keep a 12% live shadow to nf4 to monitor drift.
tess: Can we run a fidelity probe that hits the exact-match structured outputs every 90s and fail early if drop > 1.2%? Ops wants session exports for failures.
mira: Yup — probe rwd_structured_v4, interval 90s, exact-match threshold 0.988. Export failing sessions to s3://rw-inference/canary/r3.1-fails/.
devon: For product traffic, tighten halluc threshold to 0.0015 and reduce sustained window to 10m. For internal beta flows we can be looser.
sam: Also add a rolling eval that shadows nf4 on 12% and records per-session delta metrics; surface top-20 mismatch prompts to #convo-lab.
ops-bot: Canary job created but pending manual approval from eng-ml leads. Alerts: paging if halluc delta > 0.02 for 5m on primary product.
mira: I'll draft the rollout JSON and attach to the Console request. Will ping when ready. Thanks. :thumbsup:
